text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Allah, ɓe gollitiri sari'a Makko on ! Si noddinoowo on noddinanii julde nden ñalnde Juma, ɓaawo Almaami on ƴawde ka ganngunal, haray yaccee e juulirɗe ɗen fii tawegol kutuba on e julde nden, acciton ngeñngu ngun hara ngu sokoliraali on e dewal ngal. Ko on yamaruyee ɓuri moƴƴannde on, si tawno hiɗon anndunoo ɗum. Ɗoftee ko Allah yamiri on kon kisan.
